scenes.title: The Oracle's Guidance

characters.name: Aethera
characters.action: approaching and speaking to the man

scenes.narration_text: As the man waited anxiously, a figure emerged from the warmth of the setting sun. She was a woman with long, silver hair and eyes that seemed to hold the wisdom of the ages. Her name was Aethera, and she was known throughout the land for her unparalleled understanding of dragon lore. With a gentle smile, she approached the man and began to speak in a voice that was both soothing and commanding. 'I sense that you are troubled, young one,' she said. 'The weight of ruling a kingdom of dragons is a heavy burden to bear. But fear not, for I shall impart upon you the wisdom of the ancient ones, and guide you on your journey to become a just and fair ruler.' As she spoke, the air seemed to thicken with an otherworldly energy, and the man felt a sense of anticipation building within him. Aethera's eyes seemed to bore into his very soul, as if searching for something, and the man couldn't help but wonder what secrets she might uncover.

scenes.narration_text: Aethera's eyes narrowed, her gaze piercing as she presented the man with a series of ancient artifacts. She declared, 'To rule a kingdom of dragons, one must first prove themselves worthy.' She set before him three trials. Each trial would test a different aspect of his character: courage, wisdom, and compassion. He must succeed in all three to prove his worthiness to rule.
